title: Implement AdSense/EthicalAds placement with max 2 ads per page, lazy-loaded
acceptance_criteria: EthicalAds integration as primary ad network, Google AdSense as fallback
Ad component enforces max 2 ads visible per page at any time
Ads are lazy-loaded via IntersectionObserver (not loaded until near viewport)
Ad placement respects GDPR consent: ads only shown when marketing consent granted
Ad slots are clearly labeled as 'Advertisement'
Ad dimensions responsive to viewport (desktop: 728x90 leaderboard, mobile: 320x100 banner)
ads.txt file served at /ads.txt root path
